Packet limits: cmf, bar_high, cci_20 and ma_40 are not served in these packets, so COM is unread and no swing set-up can be tested; a stated partial read is used where a claim rests on them.

Weekly frames carry an open partial bar; I read weekly EMA position and distance to the 20-wk high, not the swing label alone.
